RatingLevel.description:
One band of a scorecard scale: a label, its representative score and the
band's lower bound.

min_score.description: Inclusive lower bound of the band on the 0–100 scale.

name.description: Band label, for example `AAA` or `Aaa`; outer whitespace trimmed.

score.description: Representative score of the band on the inclusive 0–100 scale.

ScorecardScale.description:
Scorecard rating-scale definition: a named, best-to-worst list of bands
that covers the whole `[0, 100]` score domain.

Named `ScorecardScale` (rather than just `RatingScale`) to disambiguate
from `finstack_quant_models::credit::migration::RatingScale`, which models
the ordered state set of a credit-migration / transition matrix.

scale_name.description: Scale name, for example `Internal corporate`; outer whitespace trimmed.

description: One registered scorecard scale with its normalized id and the provenance of its numbers.

examples.source: Example utility bands; not an agency calibration

source.description: Provenance of the scale's numbers (policy, owner, vintage).

title: RatingScaleEntry
